title: Publish Kinh Lăng Nghiêm iOS privacy and support pages

acceptance.text: Publish accessible Vietnamese privacy-policy and support pages for the Kinh Lăng Nghiêm iOS app at /kinh-lang-nghiem/privacy.html and /kinh-lang-nghiem/support.html on kiokoto.com, linked from the app and its App Store listing.

red_exception.reason: Static privacy and support documents; verify content, links and HTTP responses without a permanent implementation-mirroring test.

findings.summary: Contact is routed to /vi/feedback (stores name/email/message, handler_feedback.go:83) but the policy never says what support receives, why, how long it is kept or how to delete it (5.1.1(i); app priva…
'Không thu thập dữ liệu' + Cloudflare text published without the host/CDN log check that app compliance.md:15,39 requires first; no retention note or Cloudflare link. Owner must confirm R2 logging.
FAQ says 'Về chỗ đang nghe' appears in off-book passages; it appears only after scrolling away during an aligned passage (AudioFollow.swift:23, AudioCueIndex.swift:137).
'Khoảng 21 MB/giờ' doesn't match the app's display: the manifest gives 22.35 MB/h and ByteCountFormatter(.file) shows ~22.4 MB per hour; use ~22 MB.
Feedback form email is optional; tell users (both pages) to enter an email if they want a reply.
AC1 publication and the App Store link can only be checked after merge: both URLs 404 in prod today; confirm 200 text/html after deploy and set App Store Connect URLs.
